chunks: Sama'ah asked him about a day in the Month of Ramadan concerning which there is disagreement.
He said: "If the people of the city agree upon fasting it on the basis of sighting, then observe it, if the people of the city are five hundred persons."

key_terms.خَمْسَمِائَةِ إِنْسَانٍ: five hundred persons, indicating the city's population threshold
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the time of obligatory fasting
key_terms.لِلرُّؤْيَةِ: on the basis of sighting the moon

ai.seo_question: What should be done when there is disagreement about a day of Ramadan based on moon-sighting?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a disputed day in the Month of Ramadan. It indicates acting upon the collective agreement of the people of a city regarding moon-sighting, with reference to a sufficiently large population.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1913 - Sama'ah asked Imam (as) about a day in the Month of Ramadan over which there is a dispute.
Imam (as) said: "If the people of the city agree to fast based on sighting [the crescent], then observe it. This applies if the population of the city is five hundred people."
